thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up - onboarding for Vaultbridge is bouncing. Desktop (Electron) tests intermittently get 403 on /v1/generate, same token works from CI.

maria_cs: Customer pasted this failing curl (token redacted):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"test"}'
```

maria_cs: Failing response they saw:
```json
HTTP/2 403
{"error":"invalid_auth","message":"token missing or invalid for this route"}
```

dev_dan: do we have request-id header from the failing responses? ask them for the full raw response with headers.

maria_cs: got two ids back from them: req_3b9 and req_3ba, both 403. they said when they run the same curl on their machine with `--http1.1` it returns 200.

nate_net: strong sign of a proxy or HTTP/2 termination issue. Enterprise proxies sometimes drop or rewrite Authorization when converting HTTP/2 -> HTTP/1.1. electron tends to use node http2 libs via a shim.

dev_dan: ask them to run a raw http2 curl to reproduce and then http1.1. command to try: `curl --http2 -v ...` vs `curl --http1.1 -v ...`. if http1.1 works and http2 fails, header strip is likely.

maria_cs: they ran both. http2 -> 403, http1.1 -> 200. they confirmed they use a third-party http2 client inside their electron wrapper.

nate_net: confirmed. two pragmatic options for onboarding: 1) set the electron client to use HTTP/1.1 by default, or 2) have their infra team allow passthrough of the Authorization header in the proxy. We'll also document a curl repro to triage quickly.

dev_dan: for the SDK we can add a temporary flag `preferHttp1` to force the Node client to use HTTP/1.1 and include an extra header `X-Auth-Hint: 1` so proxies that are configured to allow that header will forward the token. I'll spin a small ticket for the SDK patch.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: eng-runtime/sdk-http1-fallback #1198 -> staging 2025-11-14T09:00:00Z

maria_cs: customer accepted the HTTP/1.1 workaround and completed onboarding checks. asked for a short KB note and a snippet in the onboarding checklist.

nate_net: follow-ups for CS: add KB steps (curl --http2 vs --http1.1 repro), guidance to ramp concurrency when they later re-enable http2 (multiplexing can mask header loss and cause intermittent failures), and recommend infra allow `authorization` passthrough.

maria_cs: noted. I'll mark renewal-risk as low but schedule a quick enablement call to walk them through prod client config.

dev_dan: added the SDK ticket and a brief unit test to exercise the `preferHttp1` flag. also flagged that heavy retry loops can produce 429 spikes if they retry on intermittent 403s; include polite backoff guidance in the KB.

maria_cs: thanks all 44d I'll attach the curl repro and the request-ids to the support ticket and close once docs land.

nate_net: filed KB article draft for proxy-surface and the curl test.

maria_cs: closing loop with Vaultbridge now.
